description: Framed Data (mgcommands.h, mg_data_type_framed; mg_stream_video_capability_flag_framed). Each step is a Control write (control), a Data write (data) or an event on the device (device_ends_audio, device_ends_video: its own stop_streaming; audio_plays: it plays out all the audio it holds; disconnect), in arrival order, with the Control notifications it causes and the device's state after it: framed, audio [held bytes, received total], video [bytes of an incomplete frame, received total, frames shown], discarded (Data writes that went to no stream), dropped (audio writes dropped whole) and anchor [frame, audio byte offset] of the last video_anchor taken. Every exchange starts on a new connection to the device below. Video access units are in Annex B form (start codes; SPS, PPS and IDR NALs on keyframes) with stand-in NAL bodies: structurally valid, not decodable, so replay with the decoder stubbed (a frame counts as shown when its access unit is complete). Generated by mg_framed_ref.py.

exchanges.name: framed video and audio
exchanges.note: Both streams open, framed once, then interleaved typed writes: video split anywhere at up to max write - 1 bytes of stream data, audio in whole frames. buffer_update's received totals and the buffers exclude the type bytes.

steps.note: change_data_type(framed), once: every Data write now starts with a type byte
video frame 1 (158 bytes): two writes, 96 + 62 bytes of stream data
video request_buffer_update: 226 received, both frames shown

exchanges.name: framed writes naming no open stream
exchanges.note: A write whose type byte names no open stream, or no mg_data_type_t at all, is discarded and counted; the next valid typed write is taken (no discard until the next change_data_type).

steps.note: change_data_type(framed), once: every Data write now starts with a type byte
a write typed VP8 while the video stream is H.264: discarded, counted
a write typed 0xee (no data type): discarded, counted
audio: 40 received (the discarded writes count nowhere)

exchanges.name: framed writes without whole stream data
exchanges.note: A write with no stream data (the type byte alone, or an empty write) is discarded and counted and changes nothing. An audio write that isn't whole frames is dropped whole; its bytes still count in audio's received total.

steps.note: change_data_type(framed), once: every Data write now starts with a type byte
the audio type byte alone: discarded, counted, audio unchanged
audio: 60 bytes, a frame and a half: dropped whole, 60 counted in the total, nothing held

exchanges.name: entering and leaving framed
exchanges.note: A repeated change_data_type(framed) is a no-op. When one stream ends, framed stays until the client's change_data_type to the remaining type, then plain Data follows; framed ends when both streams end, and at disconnect.

steps.note: change_data_type(framed), once: every Data write now starts with a type byte
change_data_type(framed) again: a no-op, still framed
the client ends video (never answered): still framed
a write still typed for video: discarded, counted
plain audio, no type byte: taken
video starts again: plain Data stays with audio
the device ends audio (its stop_streaming): still framed
a write typed for audio: discarded, counted
the next video write: taken (no discard until the next change_data_type)
the client ends audio: both ended, framed ends
plain audio, no type byte, no change_data_type: taken
the link drops: framed ends with the connection

exchanges.name: flush and video_anchor in order with framed Data
exchanges.note: flush and video_anchor apply in order with the Data around them: audio written before a flush is discarded, after it plays; an anchor binds the next audio write's first byte (a video write between doesn't take it), except that one arriving while its reply's first audio (the first Data after a gap) is still unplayed names that first sample; a flush drops a pending anchor.

steps.note: change_data_type(framed), once: every Data write now starts with a type byte
flush: the buffer emptied at once, buffer_update (the total keeps running)
video_anchor(7) with no audio held: pending
a video write: not the anchor's
the next audio write (a reply's first, after the gap): its first byte (audio offset 80) goes with picture 7
video_anchor(9) while that first audio is still unplayed: names it (offset 80)
more audio: held behind it, no anchor change
video_anchor(11) with no audio held: pending
audio: plays at once, no new anchor

exchanges.name: plain change_data_type on a device that lists framed
exchanges.note: A client that doesn't use framed switches with change_data_type before each run of writes, with no type bytes, as before.

exchanges.name: audio past the credit granted
exchanges.note: Data past the credit the device granted (its latest buffer_update's received total plus available bytes) is dropped and counted in the received total, never buffered, even where the buffer has room. Plain Data, audio alone.

steps.note: audio start_streaming: buffer_update, 4096 available (the credit: 4096 bytes)
audio, 2 frames a write, up to 4080 bytes
the device plays out what it holds: its buffer is empty, no buffer_update yet
2 more frames (to 4160): past the 4096-byte credit, dropped whole and counted, though the buffer has room
request_buffer_update: 4096 available, 4160 received (the credit now runs to 8256)
